name: Albert II
note: Duke of Saxony 1260-1296, ruling jointly (with brother John I, then nephews John II, Eric I, Albert III); after the 1296 partition Duke of Saxe-Wittenberg 1296-1298

name: Rudolph I
note: Duke of Saxe-Wittenberg 1298-1356; Electorate of Saxony confirmed by the Golden Bull of 1356 (10 January - 12 March 1356)

name: Albert IV
note: reign end '(before 12 November) 1422'; Ascanian line extinct 1422, electorate granted to the House of Wettin

name: John Frederick I the Magnanimous
note: lost the electorate 19 May 1547; Duke of Saxony (Ernestine) 1547-1554

name: Maurice
note: Duke of Saxony from 1541; Electorate of Saxony from 4 June 1547 (Ernestines displaced)

name: Frederick Augustus III the Just
note: Elector; became King of Saxony as Frederick Augustus I in 1806
